text: Over the last 30 days, several visitors noted issues with signage and accessibility, particularly the lack of clear directions to handicap parking and limited shuttle service from the parking lot to the library entrance. Some guests were frustrated by the requirement to purchase timed-entry tickets in advance, which was not clearly communicated and caused delays or prevented entry. There were also repeated criticisms of the AI exhibits, with some finding them poorly executed or distorted, and concerns that many displayed items were replicas. Additionally, a few reviews mentioned limited food options in the café and occasional crowding that affected the overall experience.
